title: [rereview] project-LICHEN-i1gk.102: misleading AES-CCM-64/CRC32 comments in caller files
description:
The comment blocks in both caller files describe features that do not exist in the actual implementation:

1. firmware/bridge-zephyr/subsys/lichen/lichen_l2.c:~991-994:
   '- AES-CCM-64 MIC if has_link_key, else CRC32 fallback'

2. lichen/subsys/lichen/l2/lichen_l2.c:~1389-1392:
   '- No MIC for unsigned frames'

The actual lichen_link_tx() at lichen/subsys/lichen/link/lichen_link_tx.c:78-81 returns -EPROTONOSUPPORT if ctx->has_link_key is set. There is no AES-CCM-64 MIC, no CRC32 fallback, and the 'No MIC for unsigned frames' comment is misleading since there's no unsigned-frame MIC at all.

Fix: Update comments in both files to accurately describe what lichen_link_tx() actually does.
